─── Spec Context ───
Session Storage Modes
Type: requirement
Implementation: in_progress
Description:
  Configurable session storage with two modes: local (default) and branch.
  Local mode writes to .kspec-sessions/ with no git tracking. Branch mode
  writes to .kspec-sessions/ backed by a named orphan branch for persistence.
  Shadow mode (sessions on kspec-meta) is legacy read-only — never written to.
Acceptance Criteria:
  [ac-config]
    Given: A kspec project with kynetic.yaml

    When: sessions.storage is set to "local" or "branch"

    Then: Session operations use the configured storage mode.

  [ac-config-default]
    Given: A kspec project with no sessions.storage in kynetic.yaml

    When: A session operation runs

    Then: Defaults to "local" mode.

  [ac-config-invalid]
    Given: sessions.storage is set to an unsupported value

    When: kspec validates the manifest

    Then: Zod validation error with message indicating valid values (local, branch).

  [ac-local-mode]
    Given: sessions.storage is "local" (or unconfigured)

    When: A session is created, events appended, or session closed

    Then: Files are written to .kspec-sessions/{id}/ with no git operations.

  [ac-branch-mode]
    Given: sessions.storage is "branch" with a branch name configured

    When: A session is created or closed

    Then: Files are written to .kspec-sessions/ which is a git worktree
on the configured orphan branch. Auto-commits on session lifecycle
boundaries (create, close, stale cleanup, compact) but NOT on every event append.

  [ac-branch-name]
    Given: sessions.storage is "branch"

    When: sessions.branch is set (e.g., "kspec-sessions")

    Then: The orphan branch uses the configured name.

  [ac-branch-name-default]
    Given: sessions.storage is "branch" with no sessions.branch set

    When: Session branch is initialized

    Then: Default branch name is "kspec-sessions".

  [ac-no-event-commits]
    Given: sessions.storage is "branch"

    When: An event is appended to events.jsonl during active session

    Then: No git commit occurs. Events are committed in bulk at session close.

  [ac-sessions-dir]
    Given: Any storage mode

    When: Session operations resolve file paths

    Then: Sessions directory is .kspec-sessions/ at project root,
separate from .kspec/ (which remains spec/task only).

  [ac-sessions-dir-autocreate]
    Given: .kspec-sessions/ directory does not exist

    When: A session create operation runs

    Then: The directory is created automatically (mkdir -p equivalent).

  [ac-gitignore]
    Given: A kspec project

    When: kspec init or kspec setup runs

    Then: .kspec-sessions/ is added to the project root .gitignore
(not tracked on main branch regardless of storage mode).

kspec init creates .kspec-sessions/ directory. kspec setup adds
.kspec-sessions/ to root .gitignore and sessions/ to .kspec/.gitignore.

3. runSetupPipeline: New step 3a-ii ensures sessions dir exists, root .gitignore has .kspec-sessions/, shadow .gitignore has sessions/
4. init.ts: Reports sessionsDirectoryCreated in output

Enhanced Setup Command
────────────────────────────────────────
ULID:      01KHFBSYT3AQTGDQXE7QSTR7QX
Slugs:     enhanced-setup
Type:      feature
Maturity:  draft
Implementation: implemented

─── Description ───
Orchestrate full onboarding pipeline in kspec setup: detect agent, install hooks
(including all PreToolUse guards), render skills, generate agent instructions,
scaffold AGENTS.md. Also ship templates in npm package.


─── Acceptance Criteria ───
  [ac-1]
    Given: a project with kspec initialized and skills in meta
    When: kspec setup is run
    Then: a summary is displayed listing each step performed
  [ac-2]
    Given: kspec setup completes
    When: .claude/settings.json is inspected
    Then: all hook entries (UserPromptSubmit, Stop, PreToolUse) are present
  [ac-3]
    Given: kspec setup completes with skills in meta
    When: skill availability is inspected
    Then: rendered skill files exist for project/local skills targeting claude-code and core skills are available via marketplace registration
  [ac-4]
    Given: kspec setup completes
    When: the project root is inspected
    Then: kspec-agents.md exists
  [ac-5]
    Given: --skip-skills flag is provided
    When: kspec setup is run
    Then: skill rendering is skipped
  [ac-6]
    Given: --dry-run flag is provided
    When: kspec setup is run
    Then: planned actions are displayed without making any changes
  [ac-7]
    Given: --status flag is provided
    When: kspec setup is run
    Then: current state is reported including agent detected and plugin marketplace status (marketplaceRegistered, marketplaceHealthy, pluginEnabled)
  [ac-8]
    Given: --status flag is provided with a broken marketplace path
    When: output is inspected
    Then: hooks status, skills rendered count, agents.md freshness, and plugin health (including path-broken detection) are shown
  [ac-9]
    Given: kspec setup completes in a project configured for ralph loop mode
    When: the installed skills are checked
    Then: skills referenced by ralph prompts (task-work, reflect) are present

─── Inherited from @trait-dry-run ───
  [ac-1] (from @trait-dry-run)
    Given: command supports dry run
    When: --dry-run flag is provided
    Then: show what would be changed without applying
  [ac-2] (from @trait-dry-run)
    Given: dry run mode is active
    When: command completes
    Then: no files are modified
  [ac-3] (from @trait-dry-run)
    Given: dry run mode is active
    When: output is shown
    Then: clear indication that this is a preview
  [ac-4] (from @trait-dry-run)
    Given: dry run mode is active
    When: command would error
    Then: error shown but no state changed
  [ac-5] (from @trait-dry-run)
    Given: --dry-run and --force both provided
    When: command executes
    Then: dry run takes precedence (no changes made)
  [ac-6] (from @trait-dry-run)
    Given: dry run in JSON mode
    When: --dry-run --json provided
    Then: JSON output includes dry_run boolean field

─── Inherited from @trait-error-guidance ───
  [ac-1] (from @trait-error-guidance)
    Given: command encounters error
    When: error message is shown
    Then: includes description of what went wrong
  [ac-2] (from @trait-error-guidance)
    Given: command encounters error
    When: error message is shown
    Then: includes suggested action to resolve
  [ac-3] (from @trait-error-guidance)
    Given: reference not found
    When: error is shown
    Then: suggests checking ref with kspec search or kspec <type> list
  [ac-4] (from @trait-error-guidance)
    Given: invalid state transition
    When: error is shown
    Then: indicates current state and valid next states
  [ac-5] (from @trait-error-guidance)
    Given: validation error
    When: error is shown
    Then: indicates which field/value failed validation
  [ac-6] (from @trait-error-guidance)
    Given: error in JSON mode
    When: --json is active
    Then: guidance included in structured error object

ULID:      01KHFBSYT3AQTGDQXE7QSTR7QX
Slugs:     enhanced-setup
Type:      feature
Maturity:  draft
Implementation: implemented

─── Description ───
Orchestrate full onboarding pipeline in kspec setup: detect agent, install hooks
(including all PreToolUse guards), render skills, generate agent instructions,
scaffold AGENTS.md. Also ship templates in npm package.


─── Acceptance Criteria ───
  [ac-1]
    Given: a project with kspec initialized and skills in meta
    When: kspec setup is run
    Then: a summary is displayed listing each step performed
  [ac-2]
    Given: kspec setup completes
    When: .claude/settings.json is inspected
    Then: all hook entries (UserPromptSubmit, Stop, PreToolUse) are present
  [ac-3]
    Given: kspec setup completes with skills in meta
    When: skill availability is inspected
    Then: rendered skill files exist for project/local skills targeting claude-code and core skills are available via marketplace registration
  [ac-4]
    Given: kspec setup completes
    When: the project root is inspected
    Then: kspec-agents.md exists
  [ac-5]
    Given: --skip-skills flag is provided
    When: kspec setup is run
    Then: skill rendering is skipped
  [ac-6]
    Given: --dry-run flag is provided
    When: kspec setup is run
    Then: planned actions are displayed without making any changes
  [ac-7]
    Given: --status flag is provided
    When: kspec setup is run
    Then: current state is reported including agent detected and plugin marketplace status (marketplaceRegistered, marketplaceHealthy, pluginEnabled)
  [ac-8]
    Given: --status flag is provided with a broken marketplace path
    When: output is inspected
    Then: hooks status, skills rendered count, agents.md freshness, and plugin health (including path-broken detection) are shown
  [ac-9]
    Given: kspec setup completes in a project configured for ralph loop mode
    When: the installed skills are checked
    Then: skills referenced by ralph prompts (task-work, reflect) are present

─── Inherited from @trait-dry-run ───
  [ac-1] (from @trait-dry-run)
    Given: command supports dry run
    When: --dry-run flag is provided
    Then: show what would be changed without applying
  [ac-2] (from @trait-dry-run)
    Given: dry run mode is active
    When: command completes
    Then: no files are modified
  [ac-3] (from @trait-dry-run)
    Given: dry run mode is active
    When: output is shown
    Then: clear indication that this is a preview
  [ac-4] (from @trait-dry-run)
    Given: dry run mode is active
    When: command would error
    Then: error shown but no state changed
  [ac-5] (from @trait-dry-run)
    Given: --dry-run and --force both provided
    When: command executes
    Then: dry run takes precedence (no changes made)
  [ac-6] (from @trait-dry-run)
    Given: dry run in JSON mode
    When: --dry-run --json provided
    Then: JSON output includes dry_run boolean field

─── Inherited from @trait-error-guidance ───
  [ac-1] (from @trait-error-guidance)
    Given: command encounters error
    When: error message is shown
    Then: includes description of what went wrong
  [ac-2] (from @trait-error-guidance)
    Given: command encounters error
    When: error message is shown
    Then: includes suggested action to resolve
  [ac-3] (from @trait-error-guidance)
    Given: reference not found
    When: error is shown
    Then: suggests checking ref with kspec search or kspec <type> list
  [ac-4] (from @trait-error-guidance)
    Given: invalid state transition
    When: error is shown
    Then: indicates current state and valid next states
  [ac-5] (from @trait-error-guidance)
    Given: validation error
    When: error is shown
    Then: indicates which field/value failed validation
  [ac-6] (from @trait-error-guidance)
    Given: error in JSON mode
    When: --json is active
    Then: guidance included in structured error object
